title: Matadragones Character Creator
description: Build Pathfinder 2e creatures from the GM Core Building Creatures tables, or import a stat block from the world's oldest roleplaying game (5th edition), Pathfinder First Edition, or Pathfinder Second Edition. Foreign systems are converted deterministically - every value is read from the published tables rather than copied - while a PF2e block is transcribed as printed. Describe a creature in a sentence and OpenAI proposes the concept while the module owns every number; drag in spells, abilities and gear from any compendium. OpenAI is optional throughout.
